measured.unmeasurable: ProfileNotConstructible: 'Tetris (USA)' declares solve.constructible: false — GenericGame hard-requires solve.y (jump/ballistic signature) and solve.lives; discover_observables.py's 3-probe protocol (forward=right/left/down, runs/onboard_wave3/discover_tetris_ {right,left,down}.json) found 0 progress candidates, no room counter and NO y ballistic signature in any direction. The candidate lives byte also named a different address on every direction (0x06BF/0x0040/0x004E), the signature of noise rather than a real global byte. Tetris's real progress (lines/score/level) is a decimal HUD field; no automated HUD-tile discovery tool exists in this repo, and hand-picking tile addresses from outside knowledge would break the purity line. Full record: runs/onboard_wave3/tetris_usa_onboard_summary.json.
